Date: Wed, 21 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0400
Subject: RFP: DPF evidence + DPA annex request

Hi Jonas,

Thanks for the demo last week. Procurement at Veridian is moving quickly and our legal/DPO team has asked for the following items to complete our vendor assessment:

- Copy of your DPA (we expect an annex we can review and redline)
- Evidence of EU->US transfer safeguards (DPF assessment, SCC/alternative transfer mechanism evidence, or equivalency write-up)
- List of subprocessors and standard notification cadence
- High-level data mapping for PHI adjacency (we'll mark specifics in the questionnaire)

I've attached our Compliance_Questionnaire.pdf and highlighted the DPF questions. Target is to have legal sign-off by 10/30 — can you confirm whether Redwood can provide the DPF evidence and a draft DPA annex by end of next week?

Thanks,
Emma

Emma / Jonas — looping in a draft DPA annex for initial review. This is a first-pass; it's written to align with our standard enterprise terms and to be redlined as needed.

Key callouts we need confirmation on from Veridian:

From: Emma Farrell <emma.farrell@veridianhealth.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 23 Oct 2026 08:44:00 -01:00
Subject: Re: RFP: DPF evidence + DPA annex request

Thanks, Rachel — the draft annex looks like a good starting point. To clarify Veridian's needs:

- We require documentation that demonstrates an appropriate transfer mechanism for EU personal data to non-EEA subprocessors. We have historically accepted: SCCs + mapping + SOC 2 attestation, or a vendor DPF assessment for services that rely on the EU-US Data Privacy Framework.
- Our DPO will need the exact subprocessors list and the last-notified date for each (we run a quarterly vendor re-check).
- Data residency: primary requirement is that customer-controlled storage for EU customers remain in EU; processing can use non-EU compute if supported by safeguards.

Procurement timeline: if Redwood can provide the annex redline + DPF evidence package by 10/27 we should be on track for 10/30 legal decision. We also need an artifact that shows Redwood's DPF statements or SCC deployment where applicable.

Emma

Emma — attaching a technical evidence workbook that maps our controls to the typical DPF/SCC requirements (DPF-evidence.xlsx). Highlights below:

- Transfer mechanism: For EU->US transfers we support SCCs and a documented DPF assessment for services relying on the Data Privacy Framework. We maintain an internal DPF checklist (controls, DPIA alignment, vendor risk scoring) — link to folder below.
- Subprocessors: (i) Cloud infra: BareMetalCloud Inc. (compute), (ii) VectorStoreOps Ltd. (embeddings caching), (iii) LogIngestCo (telemetry). We notify customers 30 days prior to material changes; ad-hoc critical updates are emailed immediately.
- Encryption: At-rest AES-256 for customer data; in-transit TLS1.3. Keys for private deployments are customer-managed via KMS/HSM options.
- SOC2: latest cert available upon NDA (we can share a redacted copy); controls mapping included in tab 3.

Drive folder (evidence): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-veridian-dpf-evidence

Attachments: DPF-evidence.xlsx

Let me know if you want a short walkthrough call — I can run through the workbook and point to the artifacts.

David
